caption: The drawing depicts a wooden furniture piece rendered in shades of green, with visible wood grain texture. The object consists of a bench-like base with four legs, a flat seat, and armrests extending upward at both ends. Attached to the back of the bench is a large, flat panel that stands upright; two rectangular support pieces, also in green, are affixed vertically at each side on the reverse side of the panel and appear to function as braces. The entire piece is illustrated at a slight angle, with the bench facing forward and the panel extending vertically behind it. The image is bordered by a thin rectangular outline, and below the drawing, text describes dimensions and possibly the designer’s signature. The background is a plain, light tan color.
title: Chest-Settee-Table-Comb
